text: This guy just bit into bread with a tiny spot of mold on it.
But that fuzzy spot is just the tip. Mold grows invisible threads deep into the bread.
So cutting off the green part doesn't work. The threads are already inside.
In his stomach, acid and enzymes break most of the mold cells apart.
For most healthy people, that's the end of it. Maybe a little nausea.
But some molds make poisons called mycotoxins, and those can make anyone sick.
And people with mold allergies or weak immune systems can react to even a small bite.
Never sniff it either. Breathing in the spores can cause breathing trouble.
So if bread has mold, don't cut it off. Throw it out.
And that's what happens when you eat moldy bread.
